$comment: Source of truth for the MDX-parity corpus. Each entry declares a fixture directory, its capability tag (the Track-C staging gate), and provenance. The gen script (packages/xyd-content/scripts/gen-mdx-goldens.mjs) reads this to (re)generate compiled.normalized.js + rendered.html + meta.json for every case. capability -> gate: prose/directive => 'full' (Rust output MUST match Oracle A + Oracle B); async => 'fallback' (exempt, tracked as coverage until the corresponding Track-C stage lands).

cases.name: async-include
cases.note: resolves the local ./partial.md relative to input.mdx

cases.name: async-frontmatter-uniform
cases.note: Composes headlessly: the gen script runs `new Composer()` so the `atlas` meta-component is registered (same as the plugin-docs layout loader). Uses `openapi: ./api.yaml` — the typed key that makes `processUniformFile` pick the OpenAPI converter; `uniform: ./api.yaml` does NOT resolve (the `uniform:` alias only infers a converter from `.ts/.tsx/.graphql` extensions, not `.yaml/.yml/.json`). Both keys funnel through the same `@uniform()` + `component: atlas` machinery. Real composed `<Atlas references={[…resolved OpenAPI…]}>` oracle — a C-S4b (Rust composer port) target: parity.rs enforces rendered.html the moment compile_mdx returns `full` for this frontmatter (it returns `fallback` today, so the fixture stays capability:async / DEFER and does not fail the gate pre-C-S4b).

cases.name: async-component-atlas
cases.note: Composes headlessly: the gen script runs `new Composer()` so the `atlas` meta-component is registered (same as the plugin-docs layout loader). `component: atlas` with no spec source composes to the real `<Atlas references={[]}>` node (the atlas transform emits empty references and drops body prose when there is no reference to attach it to — this is the composer's real behavior, not a harness fallback). Real composed oracle — a C-S4b (Rust composer port) target: parity.rs enforces rendered.html the moment compile_mdx returns `full` for `component:` frontmatter (it returns `fallback` today, so the fixture stays capability:async / DEFER and does not fail the gate pre-C-S4b).

cases.name: component-home
cases.note: Composes headlessly (new Composer() registers the meta-components). `component: home` -> the home meta-component sets layout:page and emits `<PageHome {...props}/>`, dropping body prose. No source/@uniform -> no oas-to-snippet dependency, so this is a C-S4b native target (component: home => full). parity.rs enforces rendered.html when compile_mdx returns `full`.

cases.name: component-bloghome
cases.note: As component-home but `component: bloghome` -> `<PageBlogHome {...props}/>`. Native C-S4b target.

cases.name: component-firstslide
cases.note: `component: firstslide` (no rightContent) -> the firstslide meta-component sets layout:page and emits `<PageFirstSlide {...props}/>`. Native C-S4b target. The rightContent nested-MDX compile branch is not exercised (deferred, like the openapi-atlas full-refs tail).

cases.name: outputvars-simple
cases.note: The bespoke `<<<name … <<<` outputVars fence. In a STANDALONE page (no atlas frontmatter) the JS `outputVars` node survives every remark pass and renders through `mdast-util-to-hast`'s unknown handler as a `<div>` wrapping the captured code blocks (`mdComposer`'s `file.data.outputVars` examples blob feeds only the atlas meta-component — a source-backed page that falls back — so it has no rendered-HTML effect here). The Rust port (fork `output_vars_container` construct + `output_vars` transform) reproduces that `<div>`; parity.rs enforces rendered.html since compile_mdx returns `full`.

cases.name: outputvars-multiple
cases.note: Two `<<<` fences → two sibling `<div>` wrappers. Confirms the construct closes each fence at its own `<<<` and re-parses each body independently.

cases.name: outputvars-code-group
cases.note: A `:::code-group` INSIDE a `<<<` fence → `<div>` wrapping a `DirectiveCodeGroup` stub. The `output_vars` transform delegates to the directive port (`directives::process`) on the re-parsed fence body, mirroring the JS plugin order (outputVars parse → mdComponentDirective).
